title: Saddam Chat branding fixes and correct role-based post-login routing

requirements.summary: Replace all user-facing "Admin Portal" branding with "Saddam Chat", including header, auth screen headings, and HTML document title.
acceptanceCriteria: AppHeader no longer renders "Admin Portal" and instead renders "Saddam Chat".
Login screen heading no longer renders "Admin Portal" and instead renders "Saddam Chat".
frontend/index.html <title> is set to "Saddam Chat" (fix any typos) and the browser tab shows "Saddam Chat".
No remaining visible UI text shows "Admin Portal" anywhere in the app.

file_operations.description: Update the HTML document <title> text to exactly "Saddam Chat" (fix current typo) and ensure any other user-visible meta/title branding matches.
Update the header brand text to render "Saddam Chat" instead of "Admin Portal" (logo can remain as-is).
Update the login screen heading and any other visible occurrences of "Admin Portal" to "Saddam Chat".
Update the signup screen heading and any other visible occurrences of "Admin Portal" to "Saddam Chat" to satisfy the "all user-facing occurrences" requirement.

requirements.summary: Fix post-login redirect decision order so admin/super_admin always go to /chat, and only unapproved non-admin users go to /pending-approval.
acceptanceCriteria: Logging in with role=super_admin always navigates to /chat.
Logging in with role=admin always navigates to /chat.
Logging in with role=user and approved=true navigates to /chat.
Logging in with role=user and approved=false navigates to /pending-approval.
No admin/super_admin account can end up on /pending-approval as a result of the login redirect logic.

file_operations.description: Change the redirect branching so role checks (super_admin/admin) are evaluated before any approval flag gating; redirect super_admin and admin to /chat; redirect approved users to /chat; redirect only non-admin unapproved users to /pending-approval.

Add a small shared helper to compute the post-login route from a loaded user profile (role + approved), ensuring the intended precedence (admins first). Use this from LoginScreen to prevent future regressions.

requirements.summary: Expose /admin/users navigation from the Chat header dropdown for super_admin users only.
acceptanceCriteria: When signed in as super_admin and viewing /chat, the header profile dropdown includes a "User Management" item.
Clicking "User Management" from /chat navigates to /admin/users successfully.
When signed in as non-super-admin, the "User Management" menu item is not shown.

file_operations.description: Ensure the profile dropdown includes a clearly labeled "User Management" item that calls onNavigate('/admin/users') only when userProfile.role is 'super_admin', and confirm it remains hidden for all other roles.
Verify the Chat experience continues to render ProfileMenu from the header (and thus the "User Management" dropdown item for super_admin) and that AppHeader is present on /chat.

requirements.summary: Remove any client-side routing/guard behavior that forces admin/super_admin onto dashboard-only routes or redirects them away from /chat.
acceptanceCriteria: After login, admin and super_admin are not redirected to /admin or any dashboard-only route unless they explicitly navigate there.
If an admin/super_admin manually navigates to /chat, they are allowed to stay on /chat (no automatic redirect to admin dashboard screens).

file_operations.description: Stop redirecting admin to /admin and super_admin to /admin/users after login; align both to /chat so admins are not forced into dashboard-only routes.

Review and adjust any route-selection side effects so that authenticated admin/super_admin users are not automatically pushed to /admin (or other dashboard-only screens) when attempting to view /chat.

requirements.summary: Ensure approval gating never blocks super_admin access to /admin/users; approval flow applies only to non-admin users.
acceptanceCriteria: A super_admin with an unapproved flag (if present in their profile data) is still able to navigate to /admin/users and view the user list screen.
A super_admin is never redirected to /pending-approval when attempting to access /admin/users.
Only non-admin users who are unapproved are shown /pending-approval.

file_operations.description: Add/adjust route guard logic around /pending-approval so that if an authenticated user is admin/super_admin, they are not kept on (or redirected to) /pending-approval and can access /admin/users directly when permitted by role.
Ensure the super-admin authorization guard checks only for super_admin role and does not apply any approval-based gating logic that could block /admin/users access.
Ensure the shared redirect helper treats approval gating as applicable only to non-admin users, so super_admin is never routed into the approval flow.
